caseName: Hottenstein v. York Ice Machinery Corp.
caseNameFull: Hottenstein v. York Ice Machinery Corp.
attorneys: Messrs. Arthur Garfield Hays and George D. Hornstein for petitioners. Messrs. Robert H. Richards and Aaron Finger for respondent.

opinions.text: On consideration of the suggestion of a diminution.of the record and a motion for a writ of certiorari in that relation, the motion for certiorari is denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
